# Firebase JavaScript SDK 10.12.2 (compat builds)

Unmodified copies of `firebase-app-compat.js`, `firebase-auth-compat.js` and `firebase-firestore-compat.js`
from the official npm package `firebase@10.12.2` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/firebase/v/10.12.2).

Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

They are loaded only when Google sign-in is configured in `config.js`, so the app never depends on a CDN.
